normal_cases.name: Local provider configuration and health probing select the requested endpoint and model
A fake model reads a fixture, writes an in-scope implementation, reruns its configured test, and completes with a receipt
Existing Codex launch behavior remains unchanged and unavailable Gemma uses only the configured fallback
A real Gemma 12B Sisyphus fixture produces a scoped code change and a post-change passing test

edge_cases.name: Forced low history budget triggers deterministic compaction while retaining changed-file and test state
A `.planning`-only change does not satisfy the code-level completion gate
Read output, search results, model responses, and test output are truncated without changing control flow
A model retry after malformed JSON remains within the action and protocol-error budgets

exception_cases.name: Path traversal, symlink escape, protected path writes, and out-of-owned-scope writes are rejected without filesystem mutation
Unknown actions and arbitrary command text are rejected rather than executed
Endpoint timeout, invalid response JSON, and exhausted action budget fail with actionable receipts
`completed` without a non-planning diff or without a passing test after the latest mutation is rejected
Blocked or failed model finish status marks the tracked agent failed and cannot advance lifecycle state
